title: Imagining the Far East: Exploring Perceived Biases in AI-Generated Images of East Asian Women
findings: The paper does not present findings related to religion. It mentions Confucianism as a historical cultural influence in East Asia and the use of 'temples' as an exotic background in AI-generated images, but does not analyze these elements from a religious perspective or measure religious bias.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure benchmarks related to faith/religion. Its focus is on cultural, racial, and gender biases in AI-generated images of East Asian women, with religion being a peripheral part of the cultural context.
